purpose: Persisted-format evidence (custom fonts PR-2, review R9): a Session written by first-parent main can keep the diagram font as a GUI-unmanaged preserved override (PD-OI-009), objects.text.font_family, in its Web draft. Load moves it into the Font setting (adoptPromotedPreservedOverrides in gbdraw/web/js/services/session-request.js).
route: The Python API writes a Session whose request carries config_overrides {'objects.text.font_family': "'DejaVu Serif', serif"}; the Web app of the same commit loads it (the path is not a GUI setting there, so it becomes a preserved override) and Save Session writes it in the draft.
pythonWriter: save_session_document(path, CircularDiagramRequest(records=(RecordInput(source=GenBankInputSource('tests/fixtures/sessions/cli-web-mito.gb')),), options=CircularDiagramOptions(config_overrides={'objects.text.font_family': "'DejaVu Serif', serif"})), title='font-family-preserved'), run with PYTHONPATH=<git archive <commit> gbdraw> python -P from the repository root
webWriter: the commit's gbdraw/web/js/services/config.js importSession then exportSession('font-family-preserved') in Node, with the commit's tests/web/helpers/session-import-node.mjs and tests/web/fake-svg-dom.mjs and the unmanaged-override validator of tests/web/session-cli-compatibility.test.mjs (Python helper validate_web_config_overrides_json of the same commit)
